items.title: Bill Berry and Buster Cooper interviewed by Michael Woods, Los Angeles, California, September 3, 1995
items.q: No, but I’ve worked a lot with Joe. He’s a dear friend.

ctx.x: And some of these guys have been there with that band since before I was born. You know, long before I was born. And so like any family, they had their squabbles. You know you can’t live with people that intimately 24 hours a day is what it really amounts to, and half of it in a bus, I mean that enclosed quarters, where there’s no place to go, you know, you just have to pull the shade down beside you. MR: I know they have to play soon, but do you have anything maybe about Joe Williams that — was Joe Williams with…
No, but I’ve worked a lot with Joe. He’s a dear friend. MR: We’re looking for just a few comments.
Give us a little color on Joe.
